CFG_AUDIO_HELP: Sound output, volume and mute of the kiosk.
CFG_AUDIO_SINK_HELP: auto, hdmi, analog or the name of an output.
CFG_AUDIO_VOLUME_HELP: Volume in percent, from 0 to 100; empty leaves it as it is.
CFG_BACKUP_ENCRYPT_TO_HELP: age public key the backups are encrypted to; empty leaves them unencrypted.
CFG_BACKUP_HELP: Schedule, encryption, retention and remote copy of backups.
CFG_BACKUP_PARTS_HELP: What is backed up: config, data, modules or secrets; config, data and modules by default.
CFG_BACKUP_REMOTE_HELP: Where a copy is sent after each backup; the local backup stays.
CFG_BACKUP_REMOTE_PATH_HELP: Folder on the remote; empty uses its root.
CFG_BACKUP_SCHEDULE_HELP: Time of the daily backup, as HH:MM.
CFG_CONFIG_VERSION_HELP: Version of the configuration file format.
CFG_DISPLAY_HELP: Output, resolution, rotation and scale of the screen.
CFG_DISPLAY_OUTPUT_HELP: Name of the screen output, such as HDMI-A-1; empty uses the current one.
CFG_DISPLAY_SCALE_HELP: Scale factor of the whole screen, from 0.5 to 3.
CFG_ENGINE_ADMIN_ALLOW_HELP: Networks other than this machine that may connect, such as 192.168.1.0/24.
CFG_ENGINE_ADMIN_HELP: Address and port of the admin interface.
CFG_ENGINE_ADMIN_HOST_HELP: Address that serves the admin interface; 127.0.0.1 accepts only this machine.
CFG_ENGINE_BUS_HELP: Settings of the bus that carries notifications between modules.
CFG_ENGINE_BUS_QUEUE_SIZE_HELP: How many notifications can wait in the queue of one module.
CFG_ENGINE_DEBUG_TTL_HELP: How long a raised log level stays on before it returns to the default.
CFG_ENGINE_HELP: Language, listeners, MQTT bridge, time budgets and other settings of the engine.
CFG_ENGINE_HISTORY_HELP: How many saved versions of the configuration are kept.
CFG_ENGINE_HISTORY_KEEP_HELP: Number of saved versions to keep, at least 10.
CFG_ENGINE_INPUT_HELP: Touch and other input on the kiosk.
CFG_ENGINE_INPUT_TOUCH_HELP: Accept touch input on the kiosk screen.
CFG_ENGINE_LOCALE_HELP: Language of the mirror and of the admin, as a tag such as en or it.
CFG_ENGINE_LOCATION_HELP: The mirror's place, shared by modules such as the clock and the weather.
CFG_ENGINE_LOCATION_NAME_HELP: Name of the place that modules show; one text per language.
CFG_ENGINE_LOG_LEVEL_HELP: Default level of the log: debug, info, warning or error.
CFG_ENGINE_MQTT_BASE_TOPIC_HELP: Root of the engine's topics; mm3/<hostname> by default.
CFG_ENGINE_MQTT_CA_HELP: PEM file of the certificate authority, relative to the main configuration file.
CFG_ENGINE_MQTT_CLIENT_ID_HELP: MQTT client id; mm3-<hostname> by default.
CFG_ENGINE_MQTT_DISCOVERY_PREFIX_HELP: Discovery prefix of Home Assistant; homeassistant by default.
CFG_ENGINE_MQTT_EXPORT_HELP: Name patterns of notifications published under <base>/event/; none by default.
CFG_ENGINE_MQTT_HA_DISCOVERY_HELP: Publish the entities so that Home Assistant finds them by itself.
CFG_ENGINE_MQTT_HELP: Connection to an MQTT broker; leave it out to switch the bridge off.
CFG_ENGINE_MQTT_IMPORT_HELP: Name patterns accepted from <base>/notify/; none by default.
CFG_ENGINE_MQTT_KEEPALIVE_HELP: Seconds between keepalive messages, from 10 to 3600.
CFG_ENGINE_MQTT_NODE_ID_HELP: Id of the Home Assistant device; taken from the base topic when empty.
CFG_ENGINE_MQTT_PASSWORD_HELP: Password for the broker; kept as a secret.
CFG_ENGINE_MQTT_USERNAME_HELP: User name for the broker; leave empty for none.
CFG_ENGINE_SERVER_ALLOW_HELP: Networks other than this machine that may connect, such as 192.168.1.0/24.
CFG_ENGINE_SERVER_HELP: Address and port that serve the mirror display.
CFG_ENGINE_SERVER_HOST_HELP: Address that serves the mirror display; 127.0.0.1 accepts only this machine.
CFG_ENGINE_THREADS_HELP: Size of the shared pool that runs blocking work.
CFG_ENGINE_TIMEOUTS_HANDLER_HELP: Seconds a handler may run before it counts as too slow.
CFG_ENGINE_TIMEOUTS_HELP: How long the engine waits for a module before it counts a call as failed.
CFG_ENGINE_TIMEOUTS_JOB_HELP: Seconds a scheduled job may run.
CFG_ENGINE_TIMEOUTS_RECONFIGURE_HELP: Seconds a module may take to apply a new configuration.
CFG_ENGINE_TIMEOUTS_START_HELP: Seconds a module may take to start.
CFG_ENGINE_TIMEOUTS_STOP_HELP: Seconds a module may take to stop.
CFG_ENGINE_TIMEOUTS_SUSPEND_HELP: Seconds a module may take to suspend.
CFG_ENGINE_TIMEZONE_HELP: Name of an IANA time zone, such as Europe/Rome; the system's by default.
CFG_ENGINE_UNITS_HELP: Metric or imperial units, for modules that show measurements.
CFG_LAYOUT_GRID_HELP: Number of columns and rows that modules are placed on.
CFG_LAYOUT_HELP: Grid, gap and padding of the screen.
CFG_LAYOUT_PADDING_HELP: Space between the grid and the screen edge, such as 32px.
CFG_MODULES_APPEARANCE_ALIGN_HELP: Where the content sits in the cell: start, center or end.
CFG_MODULES_APPEARANCE_CLASSES_HELP: Extra classes added to the module, for use in custom.css.
CFG_MODULES_APPEARANCE_CSS_HELP: Style rules that apply to this instance only.
CFG_MODULES_APPEARANCE_HEADER_HELP: Show a header: on or off, or your own text per language.
CFG_MODULES_APPEARANCE_HELP: Scale, alignment, opacity and header of the instance.
CFG_MODULES_APPEARANCE_OVERFLOW_HELP: What happens when the content is larger than the cell: clip, fit or scroll.
CFG_MODULES_APPEARANCE_SCALE_HELP: Size of the module's content, from 0.5 to 3.
CFG_MODULES_APPEARANCE_VALIGN_HELP: Where the content sits in the cell: start, center or end.
CFG_MODULES_CONFIG_HELP: The settings of the module itself.
CFG_MODULES_DISABLED_HELP: A disabled instance stays in the configuration but is not started.
CFG_MODULES_GRANTS_HELP: What the instance may reach: MQTT topics and web addresses.
CFG_MODULES_GRANTS_HTTP_CA_HELP: PEM file used instead of the system store for these addresses.
CFG_MODULES_GRANTS_HTTP_HELP: URL prefixes the instance may call; an entry can name its own CA file.
CFG_MODULES_GRANTS_MQTT_HELP: The topic patterns the instance may use.
CFG_MODULES_GRANTS_MQTT_PUBLISH_HELP: Topic patterns the instance may publish to.
CFG_MODULES_GRANTS_MQTT_SUBSCRIBE_HELP: Topic patterns the instance may subscribe to.
CFG_MODULES_HELP: The module instances that run on the mirror.
CFG_MODULES_ID_HELP: Unique name of the instance; the module name by default.
CFG_MODULES_LOCALE_HELP: Language of this instance; follows the engine when empty.
CFG_MODULES_MODULE_HELP: The installed module that this instance runs.
CFG_MODULES_PAGES_HELP: all, or the list of pages that show this instance.
CFG_MODULES_POSITIONS_HELP: A position for individual pages, replacing the one above.
CFG_MODULES_POSITION_HEIGHT_HELP: Number of rows the module covers.
CFG_MODULES_POSITION_HELP: A region such as top_left, or a rectangle on the grid.
CFG_MODULES_POSITION_WIDTH_HELP: Number of columns the module covers.
CFG_MODULES_POSITION_Z_HELP: Stacking order: higher is in front; 0 by default.
CFG_PAGES_DEFAULT_HELP: The page shown first and returned to; the first page when empty.
CFG_PAGES_HELP: Pages that show different modules, and how the mirror moves between them.
CFG_PAGES_LIST_AFTER_HELP: Jump to another page once this one has been current for a while.
CFG_PAGES_LIST_AFTER_PAGE_HELP: The page to jump to; the default page when empty.
CFG_PAGES_LIST_AFTER_TIME_HELP: How long the page stays current before the jump.
CFG_PAGES_LIST_CYCLE_HELP: Off takes the page out of the rotation; it is then shown only on request.
CFG_PAGES_LIST_HELP: The pages: at least one, at most 32.
CFG_PAGES_LIST_ID_HELP: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; used in the configuration.
CFG_PAGES_LIST_ROTATE_HELP: How long this page stays; replaces the rotation time of all pages.
CFG_PAGES_LIST_TITLE_HELP: Name shown in the admin and in Home Assistant; one text per language.
CFG_PAGES_PAUSE_ON_INTERACTION_HELP: How long rotation pauses after someone touches the screen.
CFG_PAGES_RESET_ON_RESUME_HELP: Return to the default page when the mirror wakes up.
CFG_PAGES_RETURN_AFTER_HELP: Return to the default page after this much idle time; 0 turns it off.
CFG_PAGES_ROTATE_HELP: How long each page stays before the next one; 0 turns rotation off.
CFG_PAGES_TRANSITION_HELP: Effect between pages: fade or none.
CORE_ADMIN_AUDIO_MISMATCH: The configured audio output was not found.
CORE_ADMIN_BAD_FORMAT: This value has the wrong format.
CORE_ADMIN_DISK_INVALID: The configuration on disk is not valid; the previous one is still running.
CORE_ADMIN_DISPLAY_MISMATCH: The display mode differs from the configuration.
CORE_ADMIN_DROPPED: {count} entries were dropped because the page fell behind.
CORE_ADMIN_EXT_FAILED: The admin page of {module} could not be loaded.
CORE_ADMIN_INCLUDE_HINT: This part is in another file; edit it in the YAML view.
CORE_ADMIN_NO_LAYOUT: The layout cannot be shown until the configuration's top level is valid.
CORE_ADMIN_NO_USABLE_MODULES: No installed module can be added.
CORE_ADMIN_PAGE_ID_INVALID: Start with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits or _ (at most 32 characters).
CORE_ADMIN_PAGE_ID_TAKEN: A page with this id already exists.
CORE_ADMIN_REPLACE_DRAFT: Replace the unsaved changes with this version?
CORE_ADMIN_RESCALE_HELP: Fit every rectangle to the new grid size, as one step
CORE_ADMIN_SELECT_INSTANCE: Select a module on the preview to move, resize or change it.
CORE_ADMIN_SELECT_TWO: Choose the two versions to compare.
CORE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_INSTALLER_BUSY: The installer is busy with another operation.
CORE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_PENDING_REBOOT: Reboot requested. Waiting for the machine to come back.
CORE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_PENDING_RESTART_ENGINE: Restart engine requested. Waiting for the engine to come back.
CORE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_PENDING_RESTART_KIOSK: Restart kiosk requested. Waiting for the kiosk to reconnect.
CORE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_REBOOT_CONFIRM_TEXT: The whole machine reboots. The mirror and this admin stay stopped until it is back. This page reconnects by itself.
CORE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_REBOOT_EFFECT: Stops everything, the mirror and this admin included, until the machine is back.
CORE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_RESTART_ENGINE_CONFIRM: The engine service restarts. The admin and the mirror's updates stop for a short while; the mirror keeps showing its last render. This page reconnects by itself.
CORE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_RESTART_ENGINE_EFFECT: Interrupts the admin and the mirror's updates for a short while. The displays keep their last render.
CORE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_RESTART_KIOSK_CONFIRM_: The kiosk browser restarts. The mirror screen goes blank until it is back. The engine and this page are not affected.
CORE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_RESTART_KIOSK_EFFECT: Blanks the mirror screen until the kiosk is back. The engine and this page are not affected.
CORE_ADMIN_SYSTEM_UNSEEN: “{action}” was requested 120 s ago; its effect was not seen.
CORE_API_CONFLICT: The configuration changed in the meantime.
CORE_API_DISK_INVALID: The configuration on disk is not valid.
CORE_API_FORBIDDEN: This request is not allowed from this page.
CORE_API_INSTALLER_BUSY: The installer is busy with another operation. Try again when it has finished.
CORE_API_INSTALLER_UNAVAILABLE: The installer cannot be reached, so the action was not sent.
CORE_API_MASKED_UNKNOWN: A hidden value no longer exists; type it again.
CORE_API_NOTHING_TO_DO: There is nothing to undo or redo.
CORE_API_PATCH_FAILED: The change could not be applied.
CORE_API_PAYLOAD_INVALID: The payload does not match the registered notification.
CORE_API_RESERVED_NAME: Names starting with CORE_ are reserved for the engine.
CORE_API_UNAUTHORIZED: Sign in with an admin token.
CORE_API_UNAVAILABLE: The engine is starting or stopping.

CORE_CFG_YAML_TAG: Tag {tag} is not allowed; use !env or !include
CORE_DISPLAY_NO_KIOSK: The display cannot be switched: no kiosk is connected
CORE_DISPLAY_TIMEOUT: The kiosk did not confirm the display change in time
CORE_DISPLAY_UNAVAILABLE: The display cannot be switched on this system
CORE_MQTT_DISCONNECTED: The MQTT broker is not connected
CORE_MQTT_PUBLISH_FAILED: The MQTT message could not be published
